heart_rate_bpm.label: Heart rate
heart_rate_bpm.meaning: Beats per minute from a wearable optical/ECG sensor.
can_infer: deviation from this astronaut's own time-of-day / sleep-aware normal
heart_rate_bpm.evidence_note: Cardiovascular adaptation is a NASA HRP risk; HR was recorded by wearables in Inspiration4 (team research report). Public in-flight HR numbers found are single-astronaut Holter data (N=1): see outputs/evidence_table.*

hrv_ms.label: Heart rate variability
hrv_ms.meaning: Beat-to-beat variability, ASSUMED to be RMSSD over short windows. The field name does not say which metric: RMSSD and SDNN are NOT interchangeable.
can_infer: change relative to the same astronaut, same metric, same device
cannot_infer: comparison with published HRV values unless the metric and window match
hrv_ms.evidence_note: 24 h HRV rhythm persisting in long-duration flight (Otsuka et al.); metric used there must be checked before quoting numbers.

spo2_pct.label: Blood oxygen saturation
spo2_pct.meaning: Peripheral oxygen saturation from a wearable pulse oximeter.
can_infer: drop or sustained shift from personal normal (still scored during exercise)
cannot_infer: reliability under motion/poor perfusion without the data-quality flags
spo2_pct.evidence_note: Measured by wearables in Inspiration4 (team research report). The only public figure collected (outputs/evidence_table.*) is ~97% in 8 astronauts under a hypoxic challenge, NOT resting in-flight. Measurement quality caveats apply.

skin_temp_c.label: Skin temperature
skin_temp_c.meaning: peripheral skin (wearable); NOT core body temperature. Typically several degrees below core temperature and influenced by ambient temperature and sensor contact.
can_infer: shift relative to the astronaut's own skin-temperature normal
cannot_infer: numbers from core-temperature studies do not apply
skin_temp_c.evidence_note: No skin-temperature source collected. Published spaceflight temperature results (Stahn 2017) are core temperature: not direct evidence for this field.

resp_rate_bpm.label: Respiratory rate
resp_rate_bpm.meaning: Breaths per minute, derived by the wearable.
can_infer: change in breathing rate relative to personal normal
resp_rate_bpm.evidence_note: No source for respiratory rate itself; only end-tidal CO2 was found and it has no engine field.

sleep_hours.label: Sleep duration
sleep_hours.meaning: DERIVED, not a raw sensor field: hours with activity_state == SLEEP per night. Real datasets that give one value per night must be mapped through engine/adapter.py.
can_infer: restriction trend over consecutive nights vs personal baseline
sleep_hours.evidence_note: Sleep loss and circadian misalignment are a named NASA HRP risk and documented on the ISS.

out_of_scope.reason: needs a radiation dosimeter; none of the five vitals measures it
needs imaging / strength / biochemical measurements, not wearable vitals

scope_note: Scientific foundation, not clinical validation: the engine reports deviations from a person's own baseline for human medical review. It does not diagnose.
